summary: Cul-de-sac head with bush on the west edge, but a home 13 m away.

best_section.where: West edge of the wide cul-de-sac turning head on Greenhood Street, against the bush

drivers.seclusion: Dense bush to the west; the nearest house is 13 m away to the south, the next 20 m, others 28 m or more.
drivers.access_and_room: Wide sealed turning head, enough width for a van beside the bush; the stretch is only 10 m long.
drivers.traffic: Dead end serving a few houses; very little traffic.
drivers.convention: No parked cars seen in either image and no signs mapped.

flags: Home 13 m away at the south end, another 20 m
Stretch is only 10 m, about one van length
Witton Creek 103 m away; ground about 54 m elevation so not flood-prone
sun_shade: Bush shades the west side in the afternoon; open to morning sun and midday sun on the sealed head.
cannot_judge: Whether residents use the turning head
